NEXUS ARENA

Compact sci-fi arena shooter. Hold the hexagonal reactor against waves of hunter drones. Use crates for cover, keep moving, and chain headshots.

60sPER WAVE
3WEAPONS MODES
∞WAVES

Built with Three.js + Sketchfab GLBs. Bar: Halo Infinite Arena — neon hard-surface, readable arena, crunchy weapon feel.

Drones flank and rush. Your pulse rifle overheats after 12 shots — burst fire. Pick up shield cores (blue) and health orbs (pink) dropped on kills. Dash through enemies for i-frames. Survive 3 waves to win. Arena is 38m across — learn the cover loop.
